name: Energized Wireless Dynamo Hatch
description:
The §5§lEnergized Wireless Dynamo Hatch§r acts just as you may expect; it will inject EU directly from an energy-producing multiblock into your wireless EU network. No need for those pesky laser conduits and LSC middlemen!

[warn]The dynamo transfer rate is the same as the laser source it's crafted with: §l65kA UMV§r. Also has a very large internal storage and will transfer to the wireless network every 100s.[/warn]

[note]Great for §lDyson§r & §lLarge Naquadah Reactor§r.[/note]
